title: clinopodium glandulosum
intro: Clinopodium glandulosum, commonly known as glandular clinopodium or glandular calamint, is a plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Clinopodium glandulosum are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Clinopodium glandulosum include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
